applies_to: Patterson-Kelley NURO boiler control, Modbus register map from Appendix A of the NURO Advanced Users Guide.
summary: NURO is the boiler controller used on Patterson-Kelley (Harsco Industrial) commercial boilers, with an RS-485 Modbus RTU port for a building management system. All values are unsigned integers in holding registers. This map covers the boiler temperatures, analog I/O, digital I/O bit maps, active setpoints, demand source and status, boiler state, flame signal, firing rate and error code.

addressing.note: The guide says register addresses start at 0 per the Modbus specification and that 40001 is added for traditional numbering, so register 100 (outlet temperature) is wire address 100 (40101).

source.title: NURO Advanced Users Guide - Appendix A: Modbus Configuration

notes: Source host: an unaltered extract of the Patterson-Kelley guide hosted by Contemporary Controls; we did not find a public manufacturer copy.
Word order: the guide says 32-bit values are sent in two registers and the total is first register x 65536 + second register, so high word first (ABCD).
All data is sent as unsigned integers; temperatures are always °C x10 regardless of display units. Sensor fault codes replace the temperature value (see descriptions).

Fan speed (134) is left out because the guide gives only 'fan speed type' without unit or scaling. The BMS control registers 171-193 (CH/DHW boiler control and BMS setpoints) are left out because the extracted table does not show their access or precision clearly.
Reading a reserved address returns an illegal-address exception.
Supported functions: FC 03 read holding registers and FC 06 write single register.

Left out: burner cycle count (151-152) and run hours (153-154). The table prints a precision of 0.1 for both, which conflicts with the 0-999,999 count range and the plain-integer example in Note 6, so the scaling is unclear.
Firing rate (135) is printed with precision 0.1, but Note 5 defines it as 0-200 = 0-100 % (50 % sent as 100), so scale 0.5 is used.

integration.summary: Set MODBUS BMS BAUD RATE and MODBUS BMS SLAVE ADDRESS in the NURO menu, wire RS-485 at 8N2, and read holding registers 100-154 with FC 03. Temperatures are °C x10.
integration.enable: Set MODBUS BMS BAUD RATE (9600, 19200 or 38400) and MODBUS BMS SLAVE ADDRESS under All Parameters > Boiler Parameters > General Boiler Settings.
quirks: Fixed format 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits.
setup: With several NUROs on one bus, wait 20 ms when switching between slave addresses.
gotchas: Temperature registers return 32768-34048 when a sensor is shorted, open or out of range.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
